description: This file defines an interface for handling stream failures within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes methods for responding to delivery failures and subscription failures, allowing for custom failure handling logic.

classes.name: IStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: Interface defining methods for handling stream failure scenarios such as delivery and subscription failures.

methods.name: ShouldFaultSubsriptionOnError
methods.description: Property indicating whether the subscription should fault upon error.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Method called when delivery to a consumer has failed after all retry measures have been exhausted.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Method called when establishing a subscription has failed.
